newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up against US dollar in Shanghai.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up against US dollar in Shanghai.

text.p: The Chinese yuan rebounded on Tuesday to close up at 8.2952 against the U.S. dollar from Monday's 8.2961, but trading was slow given a lack of market-moving news, traders said.
The weighted average price on Monday was 8.2953.
The yuan opened higher at 8.2953 and consolidated in a narrow range between an intra-day high of 8.2951 and a low of 8.2955 for most of the session.
Trading was slow with most done at 8.2952, traders said.
One dealer said the yuan still faced heavy selling at about 8.2950 despite the rebound and the yuan's steady downward trend would not change in the short term.
Dealers expected the yuan to continue to consolidate below 8.2950 on Wednesday.
The yuan closed down slightly at 6.8204 from 6.8100 against 100 Japanese yen and up at an intra-day high of 1.0705 from 1.0723 against the Hong Kong dollar.
